evidence.quote: Unfortunately, those businesses report that credit conditions remain very difficult.
Clearly, though, to support the recovery, we need to find ways to ensure that creditworthy borrowers have access to needed loans.
Our message is clear: Consistent with maintaining appropriately prudent standards, lenders should do all they can to meet the needs of creditworthy borrowers.
